channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: British Pound: Sterling shorts unwind as EUR/GBP breaks support – ING
item.description: ING’s Chris Turner reports that EUR/GBP has broken below the 0.8600/8610 support, triggering liquidation of expensive, stale Sterling shorts, especially among asset managers.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar advances as US Dollar weakens on soft data, Fed tone
item.description: NZD/USD has recovered its recent losses from the previous day, trading around 0.5680 during the early European hours on Thursday.

item.title: Japanese Yen recovers sharply from 40-year low as intervention bets trigger short-covering
item.description: The USD/JPY pair comes under intense selling pressure and plummets to the 161.00 neighborhood heading into the European session on Thursday, snapping a three-day winning streak to the highest since 1986 set the previous day.

item.title: Swiss Franc eases within range following soft Swiss inflation figures
item.description: The Swiss Franc (CHF) has pulled back from session highs against the US Dollar (USD) on Thursday, following the release of softer-than-expected Swiss Consumer Price Index (CPI) figures.

item.title: Indian Rupee gains at open, supported by further decline in oil prices
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) surrenders early gains and turns marginally lower against the US Dollar (USD) on Thursday.

item.title: Oil: Hormuz risks and US-Iran MoU tensions – Rabobank
item.description: Rabobank strategist Michael Every describes how US efforts to secure Hormuz Oil flows under an emerging US-Iran MoU were reportedly blocked by Saudi Arabia, raising regional security risks.

item.title: Nonfarm Payrolls set to show resilient US labor market, backing case for Fed rate hikes
item.description: The United States (US) Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) will release the Nonfarm Payrolls (NFP) data for June on Thursday at 12:30 GMT.

item.title: Equities: Tech slump contrasts broader resilience – Deutsche Bank
item.description: Deutsche Bank’s Early Morning Reid describes a mixed picture for US equities. The S&P 500 index slipped 0.22% as chip stocks sold off sharply, yet the equal‑weighted S&P 500 rose 0.24% to a new record.

item.title: US Dollar Index Price Forecast: Weakens below 101.50, but keeps bullish tone ahead of NFP
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), an index of the value of the US Dollar (USD) measured against a basket of six world currencies, currently trades near 101.20 in the early European trading hours on Thursday.

item.title: Gold extends gains on weaker USD; limited upside potential amid Fed bets, ahead of US NFP
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) hits a fresh daily top heading into the European session on Thursday and looks to build on its steady intraday ascent amid a modest US Dollar (USD) downtick.

item.title: Japanese Yen: Higher Japanese rates and intervention risks – MUFG
item.description: MUFG strategist Michael Wan argues Japanese rates "clearly have to head higher" after a positive Tankan survey, strong capital investment appetite and rising inflation expectations.

item.title: USD/CAD Price Forecast: Remains in tight range near 1.4200, eyes on US NFP
item.description: The USD/CAD pair trades flat around 1.4210 during the European trading session on Thursday. The Loonie pair has remained sideways for over a week, with investors seeking fresh cues regarding the United States (US) interest rate outlook.

item.title: Australian Dollar: Further RBA hike doubted – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Volkmar Baur sees only a 50% market-implied probability for another Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) hike this year and disagrees with that pricing.

item.title: Switzerland’ CPI inflation meets expectation in June: What 0.5% means for Swiss Franc
item.description: Switzerland’s Consumer Price Index (CPI) rose by 0.5% year-over-year (YoY) in June, compared to a rise of 0.6% in May, the latest data published by the Swiss Federal Statistical Office showed on Wednesday. The market consensus was for 0.5% growth in the reported period.

item.title: WTI Oil dips below $68.00 amid news of progress in the US-Iran peace talks
item.description: Crude Oil prices extended their decline on Thursday, as Qatari mediators reported “positive progress” on the indirect talks between the US and Iran held in Doha on Tuesday.

item.title: Japan’s Nagahama expects BoJ to raise interest rates again at the end of the year
item.description: Toshihiro Nagahama, a key private-sector member on Japanese Prime Minister Takaichi's Council on Economic and Fiscal Policy, comments on the Bank of Japan’s (BoJ) monetary policy decision.

item.title: Euro: Downside risk toward key supports against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang highlights that EUR/USD closed softer at 1.1376 after choppy trading between 1.1361 and 1.1423. Short-term momentum is turning lower, with scope to test 1.1360 while keeping the major 1.1335 support intact.

item.title: GBP/USD Price Forecast: Extends recovery to near 20-day EMA amid hopes of commitment to fiscal rules
item.description: The British Pound (GBP) trades higher against its major currency peers, rising 0.1% to near 1.3290 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Thursday.

item.title: Euro weakens against British Pound as softer Eurozone inflation curb pressure on ECB to hike rates
item.description: The EUR/GBP cross loses ground to around 0.8565 during the early European trading hours on Thursday. Fading expectation that the European Central Bank (ECB) will raise the interest rates this year weweighsn the Euro (EUR) against the British Pound (GBP).

item.title: Japanese Yen receives support from stealth intervention risks
item.description: USD/JPY continues its downside after pulling back from 40-year highs, trading around 162.40 during the Asian hours on Thursday. The pair loses ground as the Japanese Yen (JPY) captures support from growing trader expectations of government intervention.

item.title: AUD/USD Price Forecast: Bears await 0.6850 confluence break as focus remains on NFP
item.description: The AUD/USD pair seesaws between tepid gains/minor losses through the Asian session on Thursday as traders opt to wait on the sidelines ahead of the crucial US Nonfarm Payrolls (NFP) report.

item.title: Swiss Franc strengthens to near 0.8100 as traders await Swiss CPI, US NFP releases
item.description: The USD/CHF pair declines to around 0.8085 during the early European trading hours on Thursday. The US Dollar (USD) weakens against the Swiss Franc (CHF) on the weaker-than-expected ADP June employment report.

item.title: Japan shifts to ambush intervention tactics against Japanese Yen short sellers — Reuters
item.description: Japanese officials are moving away from telegraphing intervention risk and signaling a more targeted campaign to squeeze speculators and raise the cost of betting against the battered Japanese Yen (JPY), Reuters reported on Thursday.

item.title: Indonesian Rupiah pares losses as soft US data, Fed tone weigh on US Dollar
item.description: USD/IDR inches lower after opening at a bullish gap, remaining in the positive territory for the fourth consecutive day, trading around 18,030 during the Asian hours on Thursday.

item.title: India Gold price today: Gold rises, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices rose in India on Thursday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Approaches 1.1400 as bearish flag remains in play
item.description: The EUR/USD pair ticks higher during the Asian session on Thursday, though it lacks bullish conviction as traders keenly await the release of the crucial US Nonfarm Payrolls (NFP) report. Spot prices currently trade around the 1.1385 area and remain close to the weekly low, touched on Wednesday.

item.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Edges lower below 185.00, while near-term bullish bias holds
item.description: The EUR/JPY cross trades on a negative note around 184.95 during the early European session on Thursday. Eurozone inflation fell more than expected in June, easing pressure on the European Central Bank (ECB) to raise rates at its next meeting on July 23.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD rises above $60.00 amid less hawkish Fed tone
item.description: XAG/USD gains ground for the third consecutive day, trading around $60.20 per troy ounce during the Asian hours on Thursday. Silver prices find support following a less hawkish tone than expected from Federal Reserve (Fed) Chairman Kevin Warsh at Wednesday's ECB Forum on Central Banking.

item.title: United States Dollar Index trades subduedly around 101.35 ahead of US NFP data
item.description: The US Dollar (USD) reflects a subdued performance in the countdown to the United States (US) Nonfarm Payrolls (NFP) data for June, which will be published at 12:30 GMT.

item.title: Australian dollar holds ground vs Japanese Yen amid May Trade Deficit
item.description: AUD/JPY remains flat after recovering daily losses, trading around 112.10 during the Asian hours on Thursday. The currency cross held its ground as the Australian Dollar (AUD) showed resilience, even after domestic trade data significantly missed market expectations.
